en: The Section on the Training Rules (Sekhiyakaṇḍa)
The Chapter on Standing on One Heel 27.
The Training Rule on Receiving with Care:
At that time, the Buddha, the Blessed One, was dwelling at Sāvatthī in Jeta’s Grove, Anāthapiṇḍika’s monastery.
Now at that time, the group-of-six monks received almsfood disrespectfully, as if wishing to discard it... [etc.
... "The training is to be observed: 'I will receive almsfood respectfully.
Almsfood is to be received respectfully.

If one, out of disrespect, receives almsfood without due care, as if wishing to discard it, there is an offense of wrong-doing (dukkaṭa). There is no offense if it was unintentional … [and so forth] …
"For one who is a first-time offender.
The seventh training rule is concluded.
